Name: No more parental mail - letters from a friend
Author: lemurkat
Description:
No more mail from Mom or Dad!
Now your mail sender can be an ex-roommate, your BFF, perhaps a co-worker?

Inspired by a Facebook post where someone asked if it was possible to not receive the parental mail. This changes the sender to "Your BFF" or whatever name you want it to be! Go wild. It also changes the tones of the letter to be a little more casual and slightly flippant. If you don't like that tone - you're welcome to use this mod as a template to rewrite the mail to better suit your taste.
(You can even release it if you like, but please credit me in there somewhere).

Gifts remain unchanged. Male gendered farmers get cookies and cake, female gendered farmers get money. Not fair? Yeh, I know... see the above about editing it yourself.


Maybe if the mood strikes me I might add stationery to it later.

Delicious cake sprite visible in the image is from Vanilla Tweaks.
Their cookies will make you hungry.
